name: CDH-Bench
description:
CDH-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Counterfactual vs. Commonsense Reasoning in Multimodal Models
	

CDH-Bench is a specialized benchmark designed to evaluate the robust reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by comparing their performance on Counterfactual (CF) scenarios against Commonsense (CS) scenarios.
The benchmark focuses on identifying whether models rely on simple pattern matching (shortcuts) or possess a deeper understanding of visual and relational… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/cks19999/CDH-Bench.
reputation: A targeted benchmark for probing counterfactual versus commonsense reasoning in VLMs hosted on Hugging Face; of growing interest for researchers studying VLM shortcuts and robust reasoning.
